Akabot is a Discord bot made by a single developer, mldchan, featuring Anti Raid, Chat Revive, Chat Summary, Chat Streaks, Leveling, Logging, Moderation, Reaction Roles, Welcome messages, Goodbye messages, Giveaways, Automod Actions, Auto React and Auto Response spanning over English, Czech, Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Russian and Hungarian.
